title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: premium a product yields on the value a cover was bound for
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes the premium a cover's product yields on the insured value the cover was bound for, as used for the premium owed on the binding date.

## Rule

The premium the product yields is built up exactly as the premium charge is built up:

1. the base premium, at the product's premium rate percent of the insured value the cover was bound for;
2. then the uplift for the cover's Cargo Type on that figure (the dangerous goods uplift, the reefer uplift or the out-of-gauge uplift, and none for general goods);
3. then the contract discount percent on that figure, for a holder whose active service contract has a tier rank of at least the product's lowest qualifying rank, that lowest rank being above 0; the ranks run AHL Starter Service Contract 1, AHL Standard Service Contract 2, AHL Regional Account Contract 3, AHL Key Account Contract 4, AHL Global Account Contract 5 and AHL Strategic Partner Contract 6, and a holder with no active contract gets no discount;
4. then raised to the higher of the minimum premium per container multiplied by the cover's container count and the minimum premium per cover;
5. and rounded to the cent.

## Hypothetical worked example

Hypothetical figures only: insured value bound 400,000.00 USD, rate 0.2 percent, Cargo Type out of gauge with an uplift taken as 8 percent, a holder on AHL Key Account Contract under a lowest qualifying rank of 3 with a discount taken as 12 percent, and a higher minimum of 150.00 USD.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Base premium: 0.2 percent of 400,000.00 | 800.00 |
| Increased by 8 percent | 864.00 |
| Reduced by 12 percent | 760.32 |
| Against the higher minimum of 150.00 | 760.32 |
| Rounded to the cent | 760.32 USD |
